spec_discrepancy.issue: The task pairs the value 1 with 'the circle S^1 as the boundary of a triangle'. chi(S^1) = f0 - f1 = 3 - 3 = 0 for every simplicial triangulation: no consistent convention on face cardinalities gives 1 for the triangle boundary and 2 for the tetrahedron boundary. The value 1 belongs to the FILLED triangle (a disk).
spec_discrepancy.resolution: Both complexes on the same three vertices are constructed and both values are proved by computation: triangleDisk.eulerChar = 1 (filled triangle, disk) and circleS1.eulerChar = 0 (boundary circle). All four requested values 1, 2, 2, 0 are therefore kernel-checked, with the correct attribution.

history.gate_failure_cause: The harness compile gate runs `lake env lean <file>` with the WORKTREE ROOT as cwd (see longrun/bin/dispatch360.py compile_gate). The worktree root carried no lean-toolchain / lakefile / .lake, so elan aborted every one of the 68 compilations with 'no default toolchain configured' (exit 1) even though all authored files compile cleanly from release/.
history.fix: Added the standard worktree-root Lake shim used by the accepted sibling tasks: ./lean-toolchain (copy of release/lean-toolchain), ./lake-manifest.json (copy of release/lake-manifest.json, packagesDir .lake/packages), ./lakefile.toml (mathlib require only; no mathematical content), and the symlinks .lake/packages -> release/.lake/packages and .lake/build/lib/lean -> release/.lake/build/lib/lean. No authored .lean file was modified.

history.gate_failure_cause: The worktree-root Lake shim installed by repair 1 was destroyed between the two gate runs: the `.lake/packages` symlink had been replaced by a real directory of freshly fetched, unbuilt package sources and `.lake/build` had been removed (a `lake update`-style refetch finished at 11:13 local, just before the 11:14 gate). Consequently `lake env lean` failed for 68 of the 69 files with exit 1 and `unknown module prefix 'Mathlib'` (the bare clone of mathlib carries no oleans); no Lean source file was involved.
history.fix: Rebuilt the root Lake shim: `.lake/packages -> ../release/.lake/packages` (the mathlib build with oleans), `cp -a release/.lake/config .lake/config` and `cp -a release/.lake/build .lake/build` (hard links are rejected by the sandbox with EXDEV, so a plain copy was used), and rebuilt the three D10 oleans `Complex`, `Models`, `Moise` into `.lake/build/lib/lean/Poincare/D10/TriangulationLowDim/` with `lake env lean -R release -o <olean> <file>`. No authored .lean file was modified; the four SHA-256 digests are unchanged.
